module_summary: 64-bit shift register with synchronous parallel load and enabled left/arithmetic-right shifts by 1 or 8 selected by amount.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: 64-bit shift register contents, loaded from data or shifted per amount; module output.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: 64-bit parallel load value written into q when load asserted.

anchors.name: load
anchors.why: Highest-priority parallel-load enable replacing q with data.

anchors.name: ena
anchors.why: Shift enable; q holds when neither load nor ena asserted.

anchors.name: amount
anchors.why: Selects shift direction and distance: left 1/8, arithmetic right 1/8.

groups.name: shift_register
groups.description: Load/shift multiplexer feeding 64-bit register q under load, ena and amount control.
